description: This file defines the structure 'GenericPlayerContext' and related data structures for managing media playback state and configuration within a GStreamer-based media player. It includes class definitions, member variables, and constants used for controlling and monitoring media streams, buffers, and playback parameters in the Rialto server component.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: A structure representing a rectangular area, used for video geometry, with utility methods for checking if it is empty and clearing its values.

classes.name: GenericPlayerContext
classes.description: A structure encapsulating the state and configuration of a media player, including GStreamer elements, buffers, flags for data flow control, playback parameters, and stream info.

methods.name: Rectangle()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing rectangle to zero dimensions.

methods.name: Rectangle(int, int, int, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing rectangle with specified x, y, width, and height.

methods.name: empty()
methods.description: Checks if the rectangle has zero width or height.
